name: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
summary: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.

possibilities.title: On-call engineers can question a whole incident's logs in a single context

with.title: Qwen4-Max combines vision with million-token context
Qwen4-Max measurement shows lower task costs

possibilities.connection: Headroom compresses logs and JSON before the model sees them, and Qwen4-Max holds 1 million tokens at $1.50 per million input tokens with measured lower task costs, so an entire incident window can fit cheaply.

possibilities.title: Accounting firms can automate legacy desktop entry while client data stays internal

with.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra for computer use
Secure tunnel connects private MCP servers to OpenAI

possibilities.connection: GPT-6.1 Terra is pitched as fast, broadly available computer use, the secure tunnel lets an OpenAI agent reach private MCP servers without a public endpoint, and Headroom shrinks the tool output that each step sends to the model.
